name: Surplus Intelligence
description: Manage your Surplus Intelligence account: keys, balance, USDC approval, prices, savings, and seller offers. Does not route the gateway's model calls through SI — for that, configure SI as an OpenAI-compatible provider at <base>/api/inference/v1.
author: ProlowN <robin334@protonmail.com>
setupHints: Set INFERENCE_API_URL to the Surplus Intelligence API host you intend to use (https required, http only for localhost).

Market browsing (/inference_prices, /inference_models) needs no credentials. Account commands (/inference_balance, /inference_savings) require INFERENCE_BUYER_API_KEY; without one, run /inference_key once to mint a key with CLAWDBOT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.
/inference_approve additionally requires CLAWDBOT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, and that wallet must own the buyer key (it signs the gasless EIP-2612 permit).

Seller commands require INFERENCE_SELLER_API_KEY; without one, run /inference_seller_key to mint a key with CLAWDBOT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY. Creating offers also requires INFERENCE_SELLER_BASE_URL and INFERENCE_PROVIDER_API_KEY.

INFERENCE_BUYER_API_KEY.description: Pre-provisioned buyer API key for buyer commands.

INFERENCE_SELLER_API_KEY.description: Pre-provisioned seller API key for seller commands.

INFERENCE_SELLER_BASE_URL.description: Provider base URL used when creating seller offers.

INFERENCE_PROVIDER_API_KEY.description: Provider API key sent only to the Surplus Intelligence seller offer endpoint.

CLAWDBOT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Wallet private key used only to sign SIWE auth challenges (buyer/seller key minting, key listing, key revoke) and the gasless USDC approval permit. Use a dedicated wallet; never a server or operator key.
